membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number derived on create, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level (1-3), assigned on create: starts at 1,
                add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date. Assigned
                on create; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived on read from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

I replaced the direct level computation with a points system, exposing both `membershipPoints` and `membershipLevel`.

**Points** (`MembershipLevels.pointsForOwner`): start at 0; `+2` email present, `+1` `namesakeCount == 0`, `+2` household of 3+ (`householdSize`), `+3` tenure over 365 days.

**Level** (`MembershipLevels.forOwner`): mapped from points — `1` (0–1), `2` (2–3), `3` (4–5), `4` (6+).

Files touched:
- `mapper/MembershipLevels.java` — new points method + points-derived level, replacing the old "start at 1, cap at 3, +1 for tenure" rule.
- `mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — added the `membershipPoints` mapping alongside `membershipLevel`.
- `resources/openapi.yml` — added the `membershipPoints` property (drives the generated DTO field) and updated the `membershipLevel` description/range to `1–4`.

The acceptance test (`coreReturnsPointsAndLevel`) — a fresh owner with an email, no namesake, single-member household, zero tenure → 3 points, level 2 — passes, and `mvn test` reports **BUILD SUCCESS** (1 test class, 0 failures).
